title: Risk-weighted source-greedy preservation matched smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Relative upweighting of frozen Standard10 source-greedy margins on public high-pot states can reduce high-leverage greedy-boundary drift without materially increasing global source TV or blocking reward-supported releases.
material_change: Add a default-off public pot/effective-stack weight to the existing source-greedy margin loss; run matched Standard10-seeded legacy-contract control and treatment arms whose only configuration difference is risk max weight 1 versus 4.
baseline: Exact iter16 legacy-contract learned policy passed internal replication but failed fresh20k Slumbot at -37.1617 bb/100 CI[-58.9246,-15.3988]. Outcome-blind drift audit found ~3.3% global disagreement amplified to ~7.2% in >=30bb pots and ~5.2% stake-weighted disagreement. Standard10 exact legacy bridge fresh20k was -24.5683; old-contract greedy historical point was -11.4275; strict sampled was -48.9778. Imitation-only teacher fresh20k about -18.5025 is negative evidence.

notes: Preregistered mechanism gate: no Slumbot. Compare matched endpoint/source-state mean TV, greedy disagreement overall and for >=30bb pots, source-margin violations/releases, and gradient evidence. Treatment is useful only if it measurably improves high-pot preservation without broad collapse or eliminating release rows.
Control completed normally at 8,851 physical hands and 8,257 transition-bearing hands; treatment starts from the same frozen source and fresh optimizer with the identical fixed deal stream.

result.summary: Both 8k matched-config arms completed with audited physical/session/accounting evidence. On 50,000 identical outcome-blind source states, risk weighting reduced overall and >=30bb source TV, greedy disagreement, and source-margin deficit while preserving the allowed tensor scope and producing release rows.
result.conclusion: A public pot/effective-stack risk weight is a functioning default-off learned-weight preservation mechanism. Relative to the unweighted source-margin control, max weight 4 lowered overall TV from 0.00809 to 0.00666 and disagreement from 0.852% to 0.734%; on 11,167 >=30bb states it lowered TV from 0.01039 to 0.00946, disagreement from 0.976% to 0.878%, and mean margin deficit from 0.001628 to 0.001379. This is preservation evidence only, not poker-strength or Slumbot evidence.
result.next_step: Run one fresh-seed 65,536-physical-hand Standard10-seeded mixed self-play/procedural FIFO league pilot with source-margin coefficient 0.1, max margin 0.1, release advantage 1, public-risk max weight 4 at 0.15 pot/stack, and otherwise the prior passed 65k configuration. Audit curve drift and require fresh internal multi-anchor evidence before any external evaluation.
